Class OidcLoginProvider

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.extension.oidc.OidcLoginProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
Extension, InteractiveLoginProvider, AutoCloseable
public class OidcLoginProvider extends Object implements InteractiveLoginProvider
OIDC authorization-code login with S256 PKCE and RS256 ID tokens from a pinned issuer/JWKS endpoint.
